title: Horizon
description: An OutRun-style horizon in place of the backdrop's cross street: the road bends away past its far edge to a vanishing point under a low skyline, for Woof Way and Paws Promenade, each beside the current run screen. The camera is unchanged.

title: Sprite scale
description: Woof Way at today's scale beside 40px dogs, a 40x60 walker and 64px lanes on the same 360x560 screen, and the bigger scale with 3.5 s of road in view instead of 5.25 s, with the camera numbers for each.
